title: Exhibición de Fuegos Artificiales del Día Nacional de Singapore: Tipografía Ultra-Realista en Cielo Nocturno con Horizonte de Marina Bay
prompt: A hyper-realistic, professional night fireworks display located in Singapore, clearly displaying the 'Happy National Day' shape, completely composed of fireworks, located in the center of the sky. 'Happy National Day' seamlessly emerges from dense spark trails, glowing embers and dazzling light bursts, smooth and precise contours, clear and bright. It naturally integrates into the surrounding fireworks performance, becoming an important part of the overall visual feast, visually vivid and realistic. Behind and around the central subject, a wide celebratory fireworks display fills the night sky with cascading radial explosions, waterfall sparks and multi-stage explosions, creating an impressive depth and layering. Background fireworks brightness slightly lower to highlight the central subject. Night sky pure and deep, from navy blue to black, clear and cloudless, with minimal haze and smoke. Fireworks colors include gold, silver, white, red, blue in refined palette, showing physically accurate halo effects, delicate glow effects, realistic particle dynamics and natural intensity and timing variations. Fireworks gently illuminate the surrounding sky, bringing soft, cinematic light attenuation, creating realistic and immersive celebratory atmosphere. Image resolution extremely high, details clear and sharp, photographically realistic, without additional text or visual elements, only clearly displaying 'Happy National Day' through fireworks. Bottom can see silhouettes of Singapore's iconic Marina Bay Sands and Merlion.
